title: Intelligence acceptance và access proof
scope_items: Acceptance Target 1 (Every live source has access evidence): Verified that all live connector routes require active access verification evidence; unconfigured or unverified connectors fail closed (ErrUnverifiedLiveAccess) and never present synthetic/mock data as live observations; expired tokens (>90 days or past valid_until) transition to degraded mode with confidence downgrade, warning banner, and reconnect CTA.

Acceptance Target 2 (Future conversions remain assigned to later tasks): Downstream conversions from Opportunity (M04) to Idea (M05) and Script (M06) are assigned to Phase P3; conversions to Campaign (M14) and Live Plan (M17) are assigned to Phase P6; in Phase P2, conversions create linked drafts preserving bidirectional lineage and provenance, while execution attempts return ErrDownstreamActionGated.

Acceptance Target 3 (Empty/degraded/audit paths pass): Workspaces with 0 connected accounts present informative empty states with actionable onboarding CTAs (connect social accounts, manual CSV/import, Google Trends exploration); token expiration triggers degraded state indicators; 5-point intelligence audit report comprehensively validates RBAC permissions, tenant isolation, formula neutralization against CSV injection, optimistic concurrency (409 conflict detection), and alert storm batching.

Financial Non-Conflation Guarantee: Observational competitor prices, benchmark estimates, and opportunity profit projections are strictly forbidden from polluting M19 Operating Financial Ledger (ErrFinancialConflation).

Zero-Connector Operating Loop: Manual CSV / spreadsheet import operates end-to-end without requiring live connectors, neutralizing dangerous spreadsheet formula prefixes ('=', '+', '-', '@', '\t', '\r') and generating prioritized opportunities.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_EveryLiveSourceHasAccessEvidence (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm fail-closed behavior for unverified live sources, degraded state for expired tokens, and verified access evidence validation.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_FutureConversionsRemainAssignedToLaterTasks (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm downstream gating for M05 (P3), M06 (P3), M14 (P6), and M17 (P6) with lineage preservation and draft linking.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_EmptyDegradedAndAuditPaths (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm empty state CTAs, degraded warnings, formula neutralization, and the 5-point audit report.
Zero-Connector Operating Loop Verified: TestOperatingLoop_ZeroConnectorAuthorizedImportToOpportunity (Go -race) confirms end-to-end import without connectors.
Concurrency & Thread-Safety Verified: TestConcurrentIntelligenceOperationsNoRace (Go -race) and mobile/web concurrency tests confirm zero data races under concurrent access.
D0 Invariant Gate Verified: check_d0.sh passes with 337 active markdown docs, 165 tables, 140 tenant tables, 1,188 RPC bindings.
Protobuf 4-Target Gate Verified: check_proto.sh passes Go, TypeScript, Dart codegen, drift check, buf backward compatibility, vet, and unit tests.
Go Backend Quality Gate Verified: check_go.sh passes gofmt, go mod verify, go vet, govulncheck, race detector, and fail-closed entrypoints.
Web & Admin Quality Gate Verified: check_node.sh passes svelte-check (0 errors/warnings), vite build (SSR bundle), 100 web tests, 6 admin tests, and SSR smoke.
Flutter Mobile Quality Gate Verified: check_flutter.sh passes flutter analyze (0 issues) and 94 tests.
